{"summary":"This draft applies approved change request CR-001 (Half-day leave). Only REQ-F-001 changes: employees can now request leave in half days as well as full days. Its acceptance criteria now cover submitting a half-day request and checking that an approved half day takes 0.5 days off the balance. Because the brief does not mention half days, REQ-F-001 is now labelled assumption rather than fact. It rests on HR's confirmation in the change request until a document or decision records it. OBJ-001, STK-001, REQ-F-002, REQ-F-003 and REQ-NF-001 are unchanged. The change request allows no new items, so no open questions were added. The reviewer may still want HR to confirm two points: whether half days apply to all four leave types, including sick and compassionate leave, and whether the employee must say if the half day is the morning or the afternoon.
